colour_management: AgX (Blender) / AgXToneMapping (three.js); albedo/emissive textures sRGB, data linear

kz_core.uv_convention: UV0 in metres (1 UV unit = 1 m) unless uv_mode is "object" (lanterns: 0..1 per lantern). Texture coordinate = (u / scale, v / (scale / aspect)). On walls v points up (drip streaks run along v). Textures have v = 1 on the first image row (glTF/Blender convention).
kz_core.normal_convention: Tangent space, OpenGL / glTF (+Y = +v). normal_height.rg = XY*0.5+0.5, z = sqrt(1 - x^2 - y^2); normalScale = normal_strength.

channels.base: RGB albedo (sRGB); A = mask: foam (water/ice/glass), thinness (paper), coverage (decals)
channels.orm: R occlusion incl. baked cavity, G roughness, B metalness, A height (linear). Mip chain is supplied with Toksvig roughness (specular anti-aliasing).
channels.normal_height: R,G normal XY, B height, A wet-film mask (where water collects) (linear)
channels.macro: shared materials/tex/kz_macro.ktx2, linear, 8 m repeat in UV metres: R brightness, G hue (>0.5 cooler), B wetness/roughness, A vertical stain streaks

formulas: h = orm.a; ao = orm.r; film_mask = normal_height.a; mask = base.a
M = macro(uv / 8) ; m = macro_amount ; streak = M.a * m
foam = saturate(mask * foam_from_mask + frost_up * smoothstep(0.6, 0.9, world_normal.y))
albedo = base.rgb * tint * ao * (1 + (M.r - 0.5)*0.4*m) * (1 - 0.25*streak) * vec3(1 - 0.2*hue, 1, 1 + 0.24*hue), hue = (M.g - 0.5)*m
rough = mix(rough, min(rough, mix(0.32, 0.04, film)), saturate(1.4*wetness))
alpha = mix(1, alpha_min + (1 - alpha_min) * mask, alpha_from_mask)
emissive = (emissive_map * map_scale + emit_color) * tint * emit_strength * emissive_level * (1 + (M.r - 0.5)*1.2*emit_macro)
emissive = mix(emissive, white(max(emissive)), 0.85 * emit_core * (1 - fresnel_facing)^2)   // neon white core
three.js: apply ao as aoMap on the lightMap (not multiplied into albedo); wetness/wear/tint are uniforms.
kz_core.note: All lighting is baked irradiance (AGENT_PROMPT_3D 7.1); textures carry albedo/ORM/detail only. AgX in Blender and AgXToneMapping in three.js (7.5). Water, ice and glass do not use transmission on the phone (see each material three.note).
